title: A DOC tag that wraps over two lines in kb/public still cites a census-gone source, which the per-line scan of the sprint check cannot see
goal: No DOC tag in kb/public, one that wraps over two lines included, cites a source the 2026-10-21 census records gone unless a live source in the same tag states the claim and the gone id is dropped

run: import csv,re,pathlib,sys;out={r['id'] for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_census/2026-10-21.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if r['outcome']=='gone'};bad=[str(p) for p in pathlib.Path('kb/public').rglob('*.md') for t in re.findall(r'\[[^\[\]]*\bDOC\b[^\[\]]*\]',p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if out&set(re.findall(r'\bS-?[a-z0-9]+\b',re.split(r'[:;—]',t[1:-1])[0]))];print(len(bad),bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

repro_reason: the defect is a tag shape in kb text and the census log decides which ids are gone, so the repro scans the text with a multi-line pattern

clauses.clause: No DOC tag in kb/public, one that wraps over two lines included, cites a source the 2026-10-21 census records gone unless a live source in the same tag states the claim and the gone id is dropped

notes: Found by the sprint review 2026-10-24: kb/public/_answers.md:1599 (QG31) reads '[DOC S873, S870 - reused, see privacy/gdpr-pseudonymisation.md; not re-fetched]' wrapped over two lines; S870 (EUR-Lex GDPR text) is gone in the census (HTTP 202 from this host, a bot-block rather than a missing page) while S873 (EDPB news) states the claim. The sprint's own check scans line by line and misses a tag that wraps. Several census gone ids are EUR-Lex HTTP 202 answers: the census tool may need to read them another way before they count as gone. Parked, not in a sprint: S3 per the sprint review, so no fix in the sprint that found it. Planner 2026-10-24 (day triage, SP-4ppjbh4k): the repro was run once on the base ff0fdad94 and fails for the premise. Content item: drop the census-gone S870 from QG31's DOC tag in kb/public/_answers.md, keeping S873 which states the claim; the 202 answers of EUR-Lex are a bot block, so do not re-judge other gone ids.
